_comment: Scale-to-zero remote arms for the blackwell+ijru qwen3-30b-q3 chain (2026-09-21).
Both stages are summoned over ssh and REGISTER THEMSELVES with Sthambha (blackwell-q3a / ijru-q3b); the pillar plans + leases the chain.
blackwell's ssh login shell is PowerShell, so it uses explicit launch/stop commands (no pkill). The launch first re-points the
Windows portproxy (10.42.0.7:5562 -> the WSL VM, whose address changes when WSL restarts), then starts the WSL worker.
